purpose: Point-in-time AI-pool monthly model-ready layer for controls-only Logistic and Random Forest baselines; development targets are limited to training and validation and test targets are sealed.

membership.as_of_policy: For each formation session, use the latest known membership record with formation_date <= formation_session. Keep only membership_status=member and membership_eligible=true whose corrected member_from/member_to interval contains the formation session. Later ambiguous and unknown records are not carried forward as members.
membership.unknown_policy: Retain unknown and ambiguous states in membership_snapshot_audit.csv with reason codes; do not treat them as non-AI in the source membership table and do not include them in the active pool.
membership.identifier_policy: Use literal Instrument/RIC as security_id; no name-based mapping or issuer merge.

formation.calendar: last SPY trading session of each calendar month
formation.cutoff: formation-session close; all rolling controls end at the immediately preceding SPY session
formation.entry: first SPY session strictly after formation_session

splits.boundary_rule: Purge the whole earlier formation month when entry_session or exit_session is on or after the next split start.

control_features.fundamental_semantics_policy: Keep candidate ratios and raw provenance, but mark all fundamental and market-cap controls as exploratory because the clean inputs have unit/currency/market-cap semantics_status=UNVERIFIED. Do not claim the formal fundamental-control gate passed.

missing_policy.master_layer: Retain all active AI-pool security-month rows and NA values; no zero fill, forward fill, backward fill, interpolation, winsorization, or physical row deletion.
missing_policy.model_layer: Median imputation with missing indicators for both models, fit on training rows only and applied unchanged to validation.

test_policy: Do not read, aggregate, write, score, rank, or predict any test-period future return. Test rows may retain schedule and eligibility metadata, but target values are absent and test_target_sealed is recorded.
